input.question: Why do scars heal but leave a mark?
input.ground_truth: The skin you were born with took months to carefully grow in a controlled environment. When it gets badly damaged, your body doesn't have the time or conditions to replace it with identical tissue, so it rushes out a job to seal the wound, leaving out stuff like hair follicles and sweat glands to get the job done quicker.

Question: Why do scars heal but leave a mark?

Answer:

response.prediction: When you get a cut or hurt your skin, your body sends special cells to fix it. These cells work hard to close the cut and make your skin better. But sometimes, when the skin heals, it doesn’t look exactly the same as before because the new skin is a little different. That’s why you see a scar—it’s like a tiny reminder that your skin was hurt and had to fix itself. But your skin is still strong and taking care of you!
